title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: pressure-injury.jsx: UnstageableStrip and DeepTissueStrip; images 1, 7, 9 and 15
findings.title: Hard-coded black bypasses the approved palette
findings.problem: The eschar and deep-tissue illustrations use fill="#000" overlays. These are clinical artwork fills, not the shared drop-shadow exception, and introduce a literal color outside the supplied theme tokens.
findings.fix: Replace these overlays with an approved dark neutral token, or explicitly approve a palette exception for tissue shading.

assessment: No substantiated clinical staging error found. One minor palette-rule violation remains in the SVG.
